versions.notes: 0.3.0 stable. Themes + seasonal presets; cook-mode timers (pause/resume/restart, ring-and-hold), All-steps view, resume unfinished cooks; receipts to Drive folders; Google Form order intake with auto-poll + walkthrough; .qcr recipe export/import and a multi-cookbook library; multi-recipe & custom order items with special requests and a Start button; watermark/logo; version panel on every screen. Fixes: check-for-updates (was calling a missing module), completed orders reappearing, dropdown clicks inside dialogs, custom line prices, admin-tab lock, wheel-over-textbox, enterprise grants via a self-managed auto-discovered sheet.

Any-colour + seasonal themes; cook-mode timers (pause/resume/restart) that ring-and-hold, progress only while a timer runs, All-steps view, resume unfinished cooks; receipts saved to Google Drive folders; Google Form order intake with auto-poll; per-recipe .qcr export/import and a shared Drive Cookbook. Fixes: check-for-updates, scrollable dropdowns that save, custom line prices, new-ingredient Save button, admin-tab lock, wheel-over-textbox, 2nd-account Enterprise grant.

First release. Fixed the dialog/order-form crash (Tk attribute clash), opens maximized, fork+spoon icon; sync-thread hardening, no UI freezes on restore/update/sign-out, safe cross-device autosave, working history receipts.
